name: mods
description: Claude Code interface mods by kadragon. Claude Code only; built on the early-access function-hooks API.

statusBandEnabled.title: Status band
statusBandEnabled.description: Show the model, effort, directory and git branch, then the context fill, rate limits, prompt-cache time left and a due harness-curate run above the prompt, in two rows.

statusBandCacheTtlMinutes.title: Status band cache TTL (minutes)
statusBandCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is taken to live after a response, for the status band's countdown: 60, or 5 where the session runs on the short cache.

statusBandAscii.title: Status band in plain ASCII
statusBandAscii.description: Draw the status band's separators, effort mark and cut branch names in ASCII, for a terminal that leaves stale cells or broken glyphs behind on redraw (Wave on Windows).

limitNoticeHidden.title: Hide the usage-limit warning
limitNoticeHidden.description: Hide the dim notice Claude Code shows as a usage window fills ("You've used 75% of your weekly limit · resets … · Run /usage-credits …"). A limit reached (100%) and every other notice still show. With this on and the status band off, nothing shows the usage figures before the limit.

agentFlowEnabled.title: Agent flow pane
agentFlowEnabled.description: Add /flow, which opens a pane with this session's subagents as a live tree: each agent's status, type, task, elapsed time and tokens, nested under the agent that started it. From the first subagent it reads the agent list every two seconds, open or not, to time agents that end unwatched.
